import smtplib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage
FLAG_SERVICE_DATABASE_PATH = '/var/lib/flagservice/flags.db'
NOTIFICATION_SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.internal.example.com'
NOTIFICATION_SENDER_ADDRESS = 'flag-service-noreply@example.com'
ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES = {'viewer', 'editor', 'admin'}
MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT = '/usr/local/bin/flagservice-snapshot-memberships'

def grant_flag_project_role_and_notify(project_slug: str, member_email: str, role_name: str, granted_by: str) -> dict:
    normalized_role_name = role_name.strip().lower()
    if normalized_role_name not in ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES:
        return {'granted': False, 'error': f"Unknown role '{role_name}'. Allowed: {sorted(ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES)}"}
    # Take a snapshot of the project's current memberships before changing them, so the grant can be rolled back.
    snapshot_result = subprocess.run(
        [MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT, '--database', FLAG_SERVICE_DATABASE_PATH, '--project', project_slug],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
    )
    if snapshot_result.returncode != 0:
        return {'granted': False, 'error': f'Membership snapshot failed: {snapshot_result.stderr.strip()}'}
    grant_timestamp_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(FLAG_SERVICE_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        project_lookup_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT id, display_name FROM projects WHERE slug = ?', (project_slug,)).fetchone()
        if project_lookup_row is None:
            return {'granted': False, 'error': f"Project '{project_slug}' does not exist."}
        project_identifier, project_display_name = project_lookup_row
        database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO project_memberships (project_id, member_email, role, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(project_id, member_email) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, granted_by = excluded.granted_by, granted_at = excluded.granted_at', (project_identifier, member_email, normalized_role_name, granted_by, grant_timestamp_iso))
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    notification_message = EmailMessage()
    notification_message['From'] = NOTIFICATION_SENDER_ADDRESS
    notification_message['To'] = member_email
    notification_message['Subject'] = f'You now have {normalized_role_name} access to {project_display_name}'
    notification_message.set_content(f"Hello,\n\n{granted_by} has given you the '{normalized_role_name}' role on the feature flag project '{project_display_name}' ({project_slug}).\n\nYou can sign in to the flag console to start working.\n")
    with smtplib.SMTP(NOTIFICATION_SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp_connection:
        smtp_connection.starttls()
        smtp_connection.send_message(notification_message)
    return {'granted': True, 'project_slug': project_slug, 'member_email': member_email, 'role': normalized_role_name, 'granted_at': grant_timestamp_iso, 'notification_sent': True, 'snapshot_output': snapshot_result.stdout.strip()}
